body:
T227's arc builds its stranger file in-lesson through parseOffer, so no lesson reads
demos/tutorial/packets/ anymore — yet the packets ship in the site build (build-site.mjs
copies them), build.test.ts asserts they are emitted, and pages.yml gates their generator.
Committed data nobody consumes is drift waiting to be trusted.

Build: decide by reading, then do one of two things. (a) If the packets serve NO current
purpose (check the deployed tutorial page and any external doc that links them), delete them,
their build copy, their build.test.ts assertions, and the pages.yml gate in one change. (b) If
something external genuinely fetches them, name that consumer in a comment beside the
generator and keep the gate. The T227 lane's read says (a); verify before believing it.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) Either no packets/ references remain in the tree (grep transcript in the PR), or every
    surviving reference names its consumer. Verify: grep -rn "packets" over demos/, scripts/,
    test/, .github/.
(b) npm run check green; the site build emits no orphaned files. Verify: the check run.

Merge tier: chore/repair — self-merge on green.
title: The tutorial packets are orphaned — committed data with a gate and no reader
